hook_line: AIR POLLUTION COSTS INDIA $95 BILLION A YEAR

hook_stat.sub: Estimated annual cost of air pollution in India, about 3% of GDP

stats.label: Indians live in areas where PM2.5 pollution exceeds national safety standards
Cut in average life expectancy from long-term pollution exposure
Working days lost each year to air pollution

diaspora_bullets: Local sources account for only about 36% of Delhi's PM2.5 pollution in winter
The paper warns polluted air is a year-round health risk, not a seasonal one
news_summary: A FICCI-EY knowledge paper, 'Clean Air, Healthy India', estimates air pollution losses in India could run as high as $95 billion a year and links polluted air to more than two million deaths in 2023.
payoff: FICCI calls for explicit PM2.5 targets and year-round health planning instead of seasonal emergency responses.
